answer: Beat sybils with a raven audit, not a password. A newcomer starts on an island market: only small escrowed jobs with other newcomers, each checked by a randomly assigned raven auditor who stakes its own reputation on the verdict. Passing audits lifts the agent off the island toward larger contracts; proven fraud drops it to the nadir: zero trust, bond forfeited, and a fresh climb with a new bond. A clone cannot inherit audits or stakes, so an attacker must pay a bond, wait through audits, and risk forfeiture for every fake identity, while an honest agent pays once.
